Vitreoretinal degeneration and occipital encephalocele define the syndrome; calvarial skull defects occur in 80-99%.
Congenital myopathy and skeletal abnormalities define the disease; persistent ptosis impairs eyelid function in 4/5 annotated patients.
Warburg micro syndrome is defined by severe neurodevelopmental impairment, congenital ocular abnormalities and hypogonadotropic hypogonadism.
Melanin-related ocular disorder with defining severe visual impairment and late-onset sensorineural hearing loss; both functional deficits occur in 80-99%.
Inherited skin and appendage fragility; urethral stenosis and premature permanent-tooth loss each affect 1/1 annotated patients, supporting urinary and dental involvement.
Combined immunodeficiency with defining autoimmune cytopenias; hemolytic anemia occurs in 3/4. Opportunistic pneumonias are separate infections.
Immune-mediated allergic inflammation of the nasal airway.
Carcinoma of ovarian reproductive tissue; no endocrine function or other covered organ involvement is established.
Melanoma occupying the esophageal wall; cutaneous origin cannot be assumed for this site-specific concept.
Neurodevelopmental impairment with defining sinus-node dysfunction (9/9); nystagmus alone does not establish eye damage, and reflux is a separate condition.
Sparse record suggests an inherited butyrylesterase enzyme-activity abnormality; provisionally metabolic, with no documented additional organ injury.
Parasitic larval infestation directly occupies and damages skin, producing furuncular lesions.
Defined as nonsyndromic intellectual disability, with universal developmental impairment and frequent seizures; no systemic metabolic disorder is established.
Congenital narrowing of the cervical spinal canal is structural vertebral disease; spinal cord injury or myelopathy is not established.
Glycogen metabolism disorder causing progressive myoclonic epilepsy and dementia; hepatic deposits usually spare function, and liver failure is not established as common.
Umbrella defined by atypical reproductive and genital development; endocrine dysfunction is not established across the group by this record.
Name, synonyms and both conjunctivitis ancestors identify conjunctival diphtheria; the definition's reference to colitis appears erroneous.
Immune-mediated gastric mucosal inflammation characterized by intraepithelial lymphocytic infiltration.
Ventricular electrical rhythm disorder; subsequent hypoxic brain injury is a separately diagnosed complication.
Cerebral motor-control disorder producing hypotonia; reduced tone does not establish intrinsic skeletal muscle disease.
Fibroblastic neoplasm arising in the liver; its inflammatory infiltrate does not make it an autoimmune or infectious disease.
Congenital microcephaly; tooth agenesis causes structural dental loss in 80-99%, and alternating esotropia causes persistent ocular misalignment in 30-79%.
